blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Wednesday accused Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. of challenging the One China policy. Earlier in the day, Teodoro thanked a netizen in a social media post for listing disputes between China and other countries. “Taiwan – The People’s Republic of China claims Taiwan, while Taiwan is self-governed,” the post shared by Teodoro read. The Chinese Embassy took notice of Teodoro’s post and shared it on its own social media page with the caption: “Philippine Secretary of National Defense Gibo Teodoro is openly challenging the one-China principle.
